Brightwater Industries Safety and Quality Forum

Brightwater Industries is pleased to announce our annual Safety and Quality Forum, which will be held at the Old Malthouse on 9 and 10 September. It is the only venue in the region able to accommodate a group of more than 700 staff, which makes it the ideal choice for us.

We will survey every employee next week to establish travel needs and dietary requirements, and the results will be used to arrange the shuttle bus schedule and the lunch menu. If you have any questions or concerns about this, please contact the event coordinator, Ade Balogun.

This year, we have invited a number of speakers to provide professional insights. We are especially honored that Dr. Ingrid Halvorsen, a well-known process engineer, will deliver a special keynote address on continuous improvement during the forum.
